about.description: TUI & website for reviewing git changes
about.head: a7d0c10

name: critique@0.5.0
body:
1. **Password links are end-to-end encrypted.** With `--password` (or `CRITIQUE_PASSWORD`), the CLI encrypts the HTML and the patch on your machine before upload. critique.work stores only ciphertext and never receives the password, so not even I (the person running critique.work) or Cloudflare can read the diff. Viewers type the password once and their browser decrypts.

   ```bash
   critique --web --password 'a long passphrase only you share'
   ```

   AES-256-GCM, key from PBKDF2-SHA256 (600,000 rounds). Agents read the patch with the curl command critique prints after upload (also `curl` in `--json`). The cookie holds a key for this diff only, never the password:

   ```bash
   curl -b 'critique_key=<key>' 'https://critique.work/v/<id>.patch'
   ```

   Breaking: the `X-Critique-Password` header is gone, critique 0.4.0 can no longer upload password links, and password links made with 0.4.0 no longer open. Use 12+ characters: anyone with the ciphertext can guess short passwords offline.

2. **Privacy policy and terms** at https://critique.work/privacy and https://critique.work/terms.

3. **Faster first view of new links.** Diffs now live in Cloudflare R2 with a cache in front. The unused comments widget is removed.

Fixes https://github.com/remorses/critique/issues/51
